notes.title: Patch 22/11/2019
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35844442/c4f6f40cd1d32c54147a0ca279b2174a848ee194.png[/img]

Patch Notes
[list][*] Bug fixes.
[list][*] Discs should no longer go through walls (or at least much less frequently).
[*] Fixed camera issues when the winning player died while the camera is zooming.
[*] Players dying in the Volcano level can no longer land on the platforms.
[*] Players on sinking platforms in the Volcano level can no longer get stuck between platforms.
[*] Boulder in Temple level no longer rolls off the side of the arena.
[*] Fixed the bug where sharks could become immune to hooks and powerups for a short amount of time.
[*] Fixed the bug where sharks would teleport small distances from time to time after being hooked.
[*] Lots of other smaller bug fixes.
[/list]
[*] Performance optimization.
[*] Graphical adjustments.
[list][*] New clouds in the Castle level.
[*] The suction area of the airlocks in Space Station is more visible now.
[*] Fixed the charging animation for the bubble powerup.
[*] Shards from the broken boulder in the Temple level have much fewer polygons now.
[*] Minor tweaks to a lot of “dust oriented” particle effects.
[*] New particles for when sharks fall off the Castle level.
[/list]
[*] Other features and adjustments:
[list][*] Random button for map selection (both in main menu and end of match screen).
[*] End of match screen: Easier navigation of what map to play next.
[*] Every player can now navigate the pause menu, instead of only the player that paused the game.
[*] Players have to hold “B” to leave lobby (To prevent getting stuck in the lobby if a player disconnects during Remote Play Together session).
[*] Bots: Easy and Normal difficulty bots now have reduced movement and rotation speed.
[/list]
[/list]
